newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MART SIIMANN SWORN IN AS NEW PM.
newsitem.headline: MART SIIMANN SWORN IN AS NEW PM.

text.p: Mart Siimann was sworn in as Estonia's new prime minister on Monday, a parliamentary spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone.
The new government is almost a carbon copy of that of former prime minister Tiit Vahei, with only two ministers changed, in the agriculture and education portfolios.
Siimann is expected to keep the smallest Baltic state firmly on the path of the reforms it launched six years ago, when it quit the former Soviet Union.
Vaehi, a political veteran, quit last month after 22 months in office.
He resigned after he only narrowly won a no-confidence motion in parliament that was brought amid allegations he was involved in shady privatisation deals involving real estate in central Tallinn.
Siimann, a former radio and television station manager, is the leader of the Coalition Party, one of the two largest factions in parliament.
